_comment: Example TARGET profiles for ZeroScript. Copy ONE of the blocks below into
config.json (replacing its contents) to point ZeroScript at something other
than Roblox Studio. The default config.json has no 'target' key at all,
which means the Roblox profile - so existing installs are unaffected.
id            - must match a key in mcpServers; this is the PRIMARY server
Use anything else (e.g. 'generic') for a normal MCP server.
name / short  - display names used in the UI and in the model's prompt
offline_hint  - one sentence telling the user how to bring the target up
probe         - OPTIONAL liveness check. Omit it (or set {}) and readiness
is inferred from the server being alive and advertising
tools. 'tool' must be a side-effect-free, no-argument tool.
target that is attached but not usable.

target.name: Blender
target.offline_hint: Open Blender and make sure its MCP add-on is enabled.

target.name: your project folder
target.offline_hint: Check that the filesystem MCP server command is installed and on PATH.

target.name: Notebook
target.offline_hint: Start the notebook app so the bridge can reach it.

example_no_mcp_shell._note: No MCP at all: tools are plain commands. See NO-MCP.md.

target.name: my computer
target.offline_hint: Check that the commands in config.json exist on this machine.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List the files in a folder.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Show the contents of a file.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Search for a pattern in a folder.
